title: SiteShrimp Photo Entry — Building Defects (Landed) variant
description: Variant for landed-house defect inspections — bungalows, terrace, cluster, semi-detached. Adds typology fields that drive AI-generated severity context (party-wall propagation risk, roof-water ingress risk) and rectification scope. All variant properties optional — landed projects commonly have heterogeneous units.

storey_count.description: Number of storeys of the affected unit. Drives roof, drainage and structural defect prioritisation.

party_wall_side.description: Which sides share a party wall. 'None' for detached/bungalow, 'Both' for terrace mid-units. Affects defect attribution between adjacent owners.

roof_type.description: Roof typology of the affected unit. Drives waterproofing / leak diagnosis pathway.
